name: orbit-ring-spinner
title: Orbit Ring Spinner
description: A gyroscopic multi-axis ring loading spinner executing concentric orbital rotations with varying phase velocities.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Continuous Rotation Cycle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
